plans.idea: Faithful left-to-right reading of the original (brand → headline+sub → bottle → CTA) with a readable logo, a wide two-line text block, and a modest right-aligned CTA so the headline dominates instead of the button.
Product-led strip: the bottle opens on the far left as the visual hook, the headline reads beside it, and the logo signs off next to the CTA as a brand+action group on the right.
Brand cluster on the left (logo lockup with the bottle beside it as one identity block), a centered headline column with generous air on both sides, and the CTA anchored at the right end.
